description: Fix README inaccuracy about chat-transport tool-call argument parsing. README states: 'The default chat transport has to text-parse kiro's console output, which fabricates tool-call ids (kiro-mcp-<n>-<name>) and degrades arguments to {}'. The second part ('degrades arguments to {}') is inaccurate — the chat transport's parseKiroToolUses() in workflow-mcp.ts DOES parse the ⋮-prefixed JSON parameter lines and return real arguments. The '{}' fallback only occurs when parameter JSON is unparseable (malformed/truncated). The README should say arguments are 'best-effort parsed from log output' rather than always degraded to '{}'.
steps: In README.md, locate the paragraph about the GSD workflow-MCP server transport that contains the sentence about 'degrades arguments to {}'.
Change 'degrades arguments to {}' to 'best-effort parses arguments from CLI log output (unparseable blocks degrade to {})' or equivalent accurate phrasing.
No code changes — the implementation is correct. Only the documentation description is inaccurate.

While editing README.md, also verify that the env vars table still matches the actual env var names and defaults in the code (PI_KIRO_CREDIT_USD default 0, PI_KIRO_BRIDGE default on, PI_KIRO_BRIDGE_TOOLS, PI_KIRO_WORKFLOW_MCP default on, PI_KIRO_RESUME, PI_KIRO_TRANSPORT default chat, PI_KIRO_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS default 2700000 (45 min), PI_KIRO_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS default 2700000, PI_KIRO_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS default 600000 (10 min)) — all appear correct in the current README table.
acceptance_criteria: README.md no longer claims chat transport 'degrades arguments to {}' without qualification
README.md accurately reflects that argument parsing is best-effort (parsed when the CLI log output includes parseable JSON param lines)
No code changes made in this feature
The env vars table remains accurate (no changes needed — all values already match the code)
verification: grep -n 'degrades arguments to {}' README.md should return no matches after the fix
grep -n 'best-effort\|unparseable\|parsed from' README.md should return a match describing the argument parsing behavior
No source .ts files should be modified by this feature
findings: Fixed the inaccurate claim in README.md. Changed 'and degrades arguments to `{}`' to 'and best-effort parses arguments from CLI log output (unparseable blocks degrade to `{}`)'. Env vars table verified accurate against source — no changes needed. Only README.md was modified by this feature.
